newsitem.title: FRANCE: Coceral sees EU 96/97 wheat exports rising to 15 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: Coceral sees EU 96/97 wheat exports rising to 15 mln tns.

text.p: Coceral, the EU grain trade lobby, provisionally set a 15 million tonnes target for European Union soft wheat grain and processed product exports in the 1996/97 (July/June) season, European grain industry sources said.
The Coceral draft will be submitted to members of the European Union's consultative committee meeting on Thursday and Friday, they said.

The data may thus be fine-tuned before publication on Friday, they cautioned. The draft estimate also suggests exports of EU barley grain and processed products may reach 8.3 million tonnes in 1996/97 against 4.5 million tonnes in 1995/96.
Coceral put total grain and processed products exports at 25.8 million tonnes against 19.3 million tonnes in the previous season.
The draft report also shows the European Union may end the 1996/97 season with grain carryover stocks of 34.4 million tonnes against 23.7 million at the end of 1995/96.
